page_title: REN 1-2 MON | Rennes v Monaco 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

90+3' Arthur Theate (Rennes) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
90+3' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) steps up to send the ball in.

90+2' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Philipp Kohn makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the top right corner. The referee points to the corner flag and Rennes will take a corner.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Aleksandr Golovin goes off and Guillermo Maripan (Monaco) comes on.
90+1' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' 1 - 2 Goal! Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Philipp Kohn into the bottom left corner.
90' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
89' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) makes a strong challenge and Clement Turpin blows for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Rennes.

85' 0 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
83' Although Adi Hutter (Monaco) is just on the bench, Clement Turpin has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Desire Doue (Rennes) is coming onto the pitch as Jeanuel Belocian cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Fabian Rieder (Rennes) is penalised for holding. Clement Turpin signals a set piece. That's a free kick to Monaco.
81' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Mohamed Camara will be replaced by Edan Diop (Monaco).

79' Arthur Theate (Rennes) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
79' That's the end of the game for Takumi Minamino, who is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
78' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) prepares to take a corner kick.
76' Julien Stephan has decided to make a change. Fabian Rieder (Rennes) replaces Baptiste Santamaria.
75' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and Vanderson (Monaco) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
73' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

73' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
73' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
71' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
69' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Clement Turpin ignores the protests.
67' The free kick is delivered by Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
65' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) sees a yellow card from Clement Turpin after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
63' Here is a change. Adrien Truffert is going off and Julien Stephan gives the last tactical orders to Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arnaud Kalimuendo departs the field of play to be replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Martin Terrier (Rennes) is replacing Ludovic Blas.
62' Today's referee Clement Turpin rightly decides to book Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) for his harsh tackle.
61' Arthur Theate (Rennes) attempts to discuss the decision with Clement Turpin, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
60' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

58' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Philipp Kohn pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
58' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:9.
54' Vanderson (Monaco) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Clement Turpin didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
53' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
51' 0 - 1 Goal! Folarin Balogun tees up Vanderson (Monaco) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 0:1.
49' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
48' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Corner kick. Monaco will have an opportunity.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' Fine attempt! Vanderson (Monaco) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

41' A sweet pass finds Folarin Balogun (Monaco) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Steve Mandanda is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.

40' What an opportunity! Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
39' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Booking. Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) receives a caution from the referee.
38' Warmed Omari (Rennes) gets a yellow card. The referee Clement Turpin made the right call.
35' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
33' Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul after Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) hacks down one of his opponents. Free kick. Monaco will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
30' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Monaco.

25' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.

19' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
18' Monaco win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
13' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
11' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
11' Corner kick. Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is ready to send the ball into the box.
8' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Takumi Minamino (Monaco). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
8' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Monaco have a corner.

5' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Steve Mandanda made an astonishing save!
3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Adrien Truffert (Rennes) heads on.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Rennes will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
